text: A particle P is projected with speed V m s at an angle of 30Å above the horizontal from a point O on
horizontal ground. At the instant 2 s after projection, OP makes an angle of 15Å above the horizontal.
A uniform solid cone with height 0.8 m and semi-vertical angle 30Å has weight 20 N. The cone rests
in equilibrium with a single point P of its base in contact with a rough horizontal surface, and its
vertex V vertically above P. Equilibrium is maintained by a force of magnitude F N acting along the
axis of symmetry of the cone and applied to V (see diagram).
One end of a light elastic string with modulus of elasticity 15 N is attached to a fixed point A which
is 2 m vertically above a fixed small smooth ring R. The string has natural length 2 m and it passes
through R. The other end of the string is attached to a particle P of mass m kg which moves with
constant angular speed 7 rad s in a horizontal circle which has its centre 0.4 m vertically below the
ring. PR makes an acute angle 1 with the vertical (see diagram).
